title: The Static of Kepler Reach
author: Hazel Ravensworth
blurb: Felix Pemberton, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
